1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 g6 3.g3 Bg7 4.Bg2.strategy: Completes White's fianchetto and prepares castling. The bishop is blocked by its own knight on f3 for now, but it will bear on the centre and the queenside along the long diagonal once the position opens.

1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 g6 3.g3 Bg7 4.Bg2 O-O.strategy: Castles at once, putting the king behind the fianchettoed bishop before White clarifies the centre. A natural, useful move: the middlegame plan is chosen only after White commits his c-pawn.
